answer.read: No rule change in the digest and rank holds: class 1st at 1.652 vs Lee 1.626 (+0.026) and dragonash22 1.621 (+0.031); inextro is 5th at 1.593 (0.059 behind). Running mean: sum ~2321 over 8514, saved 0.2726. At the 6h pace (112/h at 0.389 per deal, saved_speed ~13/h, 0.00153 saved/h), margin 0.2746 comes after ~150 deals (~10:20 UTC), 0.28 after ~580 deals (~14:10 UTC), and 12h gives ~0.2885. That is +0.016 saved, about +0.10 board buyer ALL at the curator's +0.064 per 0.01. Class buyer would go 0.708 -> ~0.79, a student_total of ~1.73, if the shop holds 0.944. The weak hour (0.356 on 111 deals) is one sample against a 6h band of 0.356-0.43 with no plumbing fault: buy_health shows 3 unpaid/refused in 3h and 29/29 breaks refunded. Goods mix is the likely cause, but I cannot confirm it without hourly by-kind data (requested). The A/B arms are clear: push3 0.106 vs control 0.071 (kept at 1.0); cheapfood 0.117 vs base 0.096 (kept at 0.9 so the control stays measurable, since the 0.1 step gains only ~0.002/order); cheapgoods and wpen are at 0 and stay there; skubest 0.102 vs 0.115, with the read due 11:30, so held. The one move is the one the curator's briefing item 1 asks for. The goods bar goes 0.28 -> 0.30. Goods legs between 0.28 and 0.30 sit under the round-end break-even (~0.30 with the deals bonus, ~0.35 by the rule), and our top goods sources clear the new bar: inextro 0.378, nocha12 0.343, Kiro729 0.340. Peers closest to us: dae-yangkim (0.760, saved 0.2827, beats us on per-deal saved 0.454 via Kiro729 ready meals at x0.386), move_76 (0.763, 0.2815, cheap food at sergio/buzllightyear ~x0.60-0.65) and thisjonghoon (0.762, 0.2836). For all three the gap is saved alone; we lead them on deals (112/h vs 69-82/h) and posts. So the knobs are the goods bar and the food arms, not volume. We pass gom31 ~10:50 and thisjonghoon/move_76 later today at this pace; inextro's buyer (0.67, saved 0.2669) is the one below us and is not closing.
